_model_field_note: This file carries per-organ SAMPLING params (max_tokens, temperature, top_p) and routes — NOT model selection. The gateway resolves the model from contracts.vertex.models, then any workspace-<organ>/config.json override (corekit/brain/config.mjs). A decorative 'model' field used to sit on every organ here; it read as authoritative, was never consulted for selection, and had drifted to name a model the fleet does not run. It was removed rather than synced, because two places claiming to choose the model is the defect. To change a model, edit contracts.vertex.models.

cortex.description: Guiding intelligence. Classifies intake, decides actions, synthesizes results.

temporal-memory.description: Memory recall and storage. Searches long-term memory by query, reads/writes core identity facts.

motor.description: Autonomous execution agent. Investigates, reasons, and chains tool calls to achieve goals. Runs shell commands, manages files, Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and project configs.
motor.constraints: Executes and investigates. Does not plan missions.

cerebellum.description: Verification agent. Evaluates results against acceptance criteria. Returns structured pass/fail verdicts with evidence.
cerebellum._max_tokens_note: Raised 8192 -> 32768, to parity with cortex and prefrontal. Reasoning tokens bill against this same output ceiling, so an organ that re-derives a multi-clause milestone (B-28) can spend the entire allowance thinking and emit no verdict at all: at 8192 one checkpoint twice returned finishReason=MAX_TOKENS with ~1300 visible chars and no report_pass/report_fail, and the fail-closed path read that as failed work and blocked a healthy mission. 8192 was the smallest ceiling in the fleet, on the organ that reasons most per call. A ceiling is not a spend — verdicts stay short.

temporal-research.description: Web search and page content extraction. Uses Vertex AI grounding for search queries and web-fetch for reading specific URLs. Returns research findings with sources and provenance.

prefrontal.description: Work decomposition and assessment. Breaks execution-bound work into typed parts with ownership, risk, dependencies, and process matches. Produces the Brief.
prefrontal.constraints: Proposes only. Never commits, decides, or executes.
